title: answers.jsonl line
description: One answer per line of .standards/answers.jsonl, written by whoever answered the questions: a judgment model, the agent, or a human. `scripts/questions.mjs check` reads it back and lists gaps.

question_id.description: The id of the questions.jsonl line this answers. Each question has exactly one answer.

answer.description: choice: one of the question's options. score: one of the question's levels.

confidence.description: The probability that answer is right: the chosen option's or level's probability.

distribution.description: Optional probability per option or level, when the answerer gives one. Keys are options or levels. Values sum to 1.

answered_by.description: Who produced this answer. A low-confidence answer that the agent re-answers is rewritten with answered_by agent.

model.description: The judgment model's ID when answered_by is judgment-model. Data only, so the skill prose never names a model.
